snippet.title: STARDUST: Wish of Witch | Official Consoles Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Coming 14th December 2026! Wishlist STARDUST on PS5 now! https://store.playstation.com/concept/10020787/

Pre-Order Physical Edition: https://direct.silverliningint.com/search?q=STARDUST%3A+WISH+OF+WITCH&options%5Bprefix%5D=last

STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

#STARDUST #srpgaming #srpg #indiegames #pixelart
